next_experiments.title: Identify the actual halfword-extension producers
next_experiments.evidence: Both previous and new selected matchers execute 2,097,082 UXTH instructions on random1M.
next_experiments.experiment: Trace actual hot UXTH operands in VCode/counters. Do not assume these are loads; they may be necessary packed-cache truncations or redundant masks of newly narrowed shifts.
